about: Only the world’s most ruthless Warden can contain the world’s most ruthless inmates. Design and develop your personalized penitentiary in Prison Architect.

Key Features:Customized Confinement Allocate resources to optimize your compound, but don’t restrict the flow of the crowd lest you encounter a flood, fire, fight, or full-blown riot.Invest and Innovate Tap federal money with grant applications…

Detention by Design Each prisoner’s criminal history requires custom treatment programs, labor schedules, and reform workshops.Lockdown Showdown Attempt a high-stakes escape of your own supermax prison in Escape Mode, or try Online mode to test…
Expand your empire limitlessly in Sandbox mode.
